example_semantic_review.OnlineSoftmax: New native Python from the independent softmax specification, not recovered historical source. Both complete FP32 algorithms retain max/sub/libdevice.exp/sum/div and the online source keeps both input passes and every store. Scalar full initializers keep loop state FP32; native maximum keeps its typed primitive. Both complete source erasures equal the explicit mathematical proof counterparts, preserving all original Real targets, bounds, execution, safety, output windows and frames. Re-prove the actual FP32 source pair under exactly the existing primitive rules and schedules; numerical requirements use actual FP32-loaded inputs. The recurrence-only and loaded-row prefixes are proof decompositions of the complete source, linked by complete-body equalities; they are not claimed as standalone native JITs. The optional read-only observation remains a successful full-row observation with a complete frame and uses the actual source prefix through its second typed input read. It observes that loaded row register instead of silently reading untyped backing values. No numerical laws or input restrictions are added.
